title: Concept: Dependency declared with a bare owner/repo shorthand
description: package.json declares a bare `owner/repo` specifier, which npm expands to a GitHub install, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The specifier names a repository rather than a published artifact, so no registry integrity protects the tree that is compiled.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: The specifier names a repository rather than a published artifact, so no registry integrity protects the tree that is compiled.
